cause_quote: The new Cancel path used `if (!current() || !(await loadConfig(state)) || !current()) {`, calling the reader outside the shared load registry and allowing polling to supersede it.
user_saw: When applied-config polling overlapped a failed Cancel reload, the plugin credential editor kept the draft and showed the previous save error instead of the reload error.
summary: The fix registers credential Cancel reads with the shared config loader and lets explicit reads replace transient errors while preserving unresolved draft conflicts.
reasoning: The introducing diff added the credential editor, wired Cancel to the new field-discard handler, and called `loadConfig` directly from that handler. I checked that applied-config polling already used the shared load registry before the feature landed and that the reader ignores errors from superseded requests, so the race shipped with the credential Cancel feature.
